notes: New: Record any live radio stream straight from the Now Playing screen - saved to your device's Music/Tarang folder so it's easy to find in a file manager or another music app. Improved: Settings' language list (Radio/TV) now has a search box once there are enough detected languages to make scrolling through them painful. Fixed: Recordings are now saved in the format the station actually streams (MP3/AAC/OGG/etc.) instead of always being labeled .mp3. The record button and playback speed control now have proper TalkBack labels.
